releases.name: v1.0.0
releases.notes:
## What this is

`skill_management` adds a switchboard for the skills installed in your OpenCode setup: see what is installed, find out why one will not load, take one out of the model's view, and put it back.

Disabling never touches skill files. It writes **one** `skill` permission rule into your global config (`effect: "deny"`, or `"ask"` for a soft disable). Nothing is deleted, moved or rewritten, and removing that rule restores the skill exactly as it was.

This is the first stable release: the surface described below is frozen for 1.x.

## What it does

| Action | What it does | Writes config |
|---|---|---|
| `list` | Every registered skill with its effective state for the calling agent (`available` / `disabled` / `ask`) | no |
| `inspect` | Why one skill is (un)available: the matching rule, per-agent differences, how its id was derived | no |
| `disable` | Hide it from the model and reject loading it (`effect: "ask"` keeps it listed and asks on load) | yes |
| `enable` | Remove the blocking rule again, whoever wrote it | yes |

How a permission is resolved: the host reads the rule set of **the agent that is calling**, takes the last match (`findLast`) with `*` / `?` globs, and — when nothing matches — falls back to `ask`, not `allow`. That is why `list` and `inspect` evaluate per agent and name the agent they used.

en.headline: 40 commits across four repositories and one v1.0.0 release
en.summary: **40 commits** were recorded across four repositories, with 28 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, 32 own commits adopted Apache-2.0, added documentation and a path diagram, scoped toast CSS selectors, exposed review flags, validated review responses, and fixed provider protocol lookup. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 4 own commits decoupled the provider chain into `config/providers.json`, connected Nvidia paths to the daily-report chain, changed CI models to `opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash`, and retired the Minimax and Longcat free paths. `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` received 3 own commits for release policy, acceptance notes, and version `1.0.0`, while `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` added one knowledge document. The `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` release `v1.0.0` introduced a skill switchboard with `list` and `inspect` actions and config-based disabling that does not delete or move skill files. A reply from `openchamber-bot[bot]` confirmed the unconditional improve-action arming behavior in `openchamber/openchamber` issue #5489.

releaseNotes.summary: This first stable release adds a switchboard for OpenCode skills, including `list` and `inspect` actions. Disabling a skill writes a single `skill` permission rule to global configuration without deleting, moving, or rewriting skill files.

zh.headline: 四个仓库共 40 次提交，并发布 v1.0.0
zh.summary: 当天共记录 **40 次提交**，另有 28 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 的 32 次本人提交涵盖 Apache-2.0 采用、文档与路径图补充、toast CSS 选择器限定、review 标记暴露、review 响应校验及 provider 协议查找修复。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 4 次本人提交将 provider 链解耦到 `config/providers.json`，接入 Nvidia 路径，将 CI 模型改为 `opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash`，并下线 Minimax 与 Longcat 免费链。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 通过 3 次本人提交补充发布政策、验收记录及版本 `1.0.0`，`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 则新增一份知识文档。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 发布 `v1.0.0`，提供包含 `list` 与 `inspect` 的技能切换台，并可通过配置禁用技能而不删除或移动技能文件。`openchamber-bot[bot]` 在 `openchamber/openchamber` issue #5489 中回复，确认 improve 操作会无条件触发执行目标。

releaseNotes.summary: 首个稳定版本提供 OpenCode 技能切换台，包含 `list` 与 `inspect` 操作。禁用技能时仅向全局配置写入一条 `skill` 权限规则，不删除、移动或重写技能文件。
